name: Lentil (Masoor)
soil_benefit: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen (~30-50 kg N/ha) and restores depleted soil.
climate_resilience: High drought tolerance once established; low water footprint.
yield_potential: Moderate economic yield with minimal synthetic fertilizer inputs.

name: Mustard / Rapeseed
soil_benefit: Biofumigation effect suppresses soil-borne nematodes and fungal pathogens.
climate_resilience: Moderate water stress tolerance; breaks weed and disease cycles.
yield_potential: High market cash-crop value with a short 80-90 day growth cycle.

name: Wheat
soil_benefit: Dense fibrous root system improves soil structure and aeration.
climate_resilience: Sensitive to terminal heat stress above 30°C during grain filling.
yield_potential: High caloric and market grain yield under balanced moisture.

name: Maize (Corn)
soil_benefit: Generates substantial organic biomass residues when tilled into soil.
climate_resilience: Moderate drought tolerance, but vulnerable to drought during silking.
yield_potential: Very high biomass and commercial grain yield potential.

name: Chickpea (Gram)
soil_benefit: High biological nitrogen fixation and deep taproot system.
yield_potential: High nutritional density and strong market price stability.

name: Mung Bean (Green Gram)
soil_benefit: Rapid 60-day legume cover crop that enriches nitrogen.

name: Groundnut (Peanut)
soil_benefit: Canopy covers topsoil against erosion and fixes nitrogen.
yield_potential: High-value edible oil and protein crop.

name: Rice (Boro / Summer)
soil_benefit: Anaerobic cycles suppress terrestrial soil weeds.
climate_resilience: Low drought tolerance; requires regular water.
